assets.name: workstation
assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph for an adult digital-literacy lesson. A believable modest home workstation used by an older adult: ordinary computer monitor, full-size keyboard and mouse, comfortable over-ear headset neatly beside the monitor, compact home printer with a single sheet emerging, and a small notebook. A tidy but lived-in wooden desk beside a window, subtle signs of everyday use, realistic cables and physically plausible equipment. Monitor displays a simple fictional browser article with generous text scaling, with no legible words or logos. Soft natural window light, realistic neutral colors, restrained navy accents only where natural, authentic materials, documentary photography, eye-level three-quarter composition, deep enough focus to recognize the tools. Landscape 3:2 composition with generous margins. No people, no branding, no watermarks. This must look like a real photograph, not a 3D render, miniature, toy, illustration, or luxury showroom.
assets.alt: Everyday workstation with printer, keyboard and headset.
assets.review_note: Corrected candidate ID after visual review: prior UI fourth maps to first returned media entry. Neutral browser screen; do not use tiny browser chrome as instruction.

assets.name: safety
assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph for an adult digital-literacy lesson about independently checking an unexpected message. Over-the-shoulder view of an older adult seated at an ordinary home desk, with their face mostly outside the frame. A smartphone resting securely on a stand shows one fictional incoming message represented by a small envelope icon and indistinct short text lines; beside it an open laptop shows a separately opened fictional contact directory with simple contact rows and phone icons. A handwritten contact notebook is nearby but all writing is out of focus and unreadable. The person is calmly comparing the two devices, with one naturally posed hand resting beside the laptop. Show ordinary lived-in surroundings, plausible anatomy and device proportions, soft daylight, natural neutral colors, authentic texture and documentary photographic realism. Landscape 3:2, close enough to understand the relationship between devices, generous margins. No real personal information, legible text, logos, military insignia, padlocks, shields, danger overlays, watermarks, or dramatic hacker imagery. A real-life photograph look, not a 3D render or illustration.
assets.alt: Older adult comparing a phone message with a laptop contact directory.
assets.review_note: Raw photo phone contains generated gibberish. Consumers MUST mask phone message and laptop content with authored fictional UI; this source photo alone is not final learner-ready.
